claim: MeshParser (MeshUnpacker) is a Windows C++ tool that converts SoW .mesh (magic MMSH) to/from FBX via Assimp, supporting static meshes only, and the repo ships prebuilt Assimp DLL/LIB binaries.
evidence: README: converts mesh and fbx, 'Supports static meshes'; Libraries/ contains assimp-vc143-mt.dll.
game_build_compatibility: UNKNOWN - source does not state a game build; not checked against 1.0.8874.0 / build 3095001
verification_method: Read README and headers in the clone; nothing built or run.
limitations: Asset modding only; no relevance to runtime networking. Prebuilt binaries are untrusted and must not be executed.
next_experiment: None for co-op; optionally useful later for a visual marker on the second player model.
